question: Within four documented active open-end US equity funds, do intervals of net outflow coincide with relative reductions of retained common holdings versus other funds in the same securities and exact dates?
selection_reason: Named candidate funds selected before inspecting flows or holdings changes; shared exact reporting dates; not representative universe
filings: NPORT-P; exactly one accession per series-date; stop on ambiguity rather than arbitrary last

eligible_holdings.cusip: 9 alphanumeric format; identifier validity not fully proven
eligible_holdings.duplicate_rows: aggregate same accession+CUSIP+unit+currency only when issuer identity fields agree; otherwise exclude as ambiguous
eligible_holdings.identity: equal CUSIP, unit, currency across dates; exclude known issuer LEI/title conflict; name whitespace normalization allowed

outcome: log(q1/q0) minus mean log quantity change of other eligible funds in same CUSIP and exact interval; at least 2 funds; report exp(mean_difference)-1 as relative multiplicative adjustment
fund_interval_summary: equal-weight securities inside fund interval; 12 equal-status rows, no pooled stock-count significance
flow: sum across current filing 3 months(sales-redemptions)/prior filing net assets; reinvestment displayed separately; missing fields never zero
coverage: matched securities count and opening eligible equity value share; entries/exits/identity-conflicts/retained without peers separately; no absent holding imputation
baseline: other funds same-security same-interval mean quantity change; each target excluded from own baseline
performance_and_increment: behavior direction/magnitude and counterexamples only; return/risk/trading-cost value unassessed
unknowns: common multiplicative split cancels but nonuniform corporate actions remain
fund outflows endogenous and portfolio outlook confounded
two transformed mirrors not direct official original verification
stop_conditions: missing required periods or monthly flows
output_policy: large/intermediate results only saved storage-plan output/behavior-pilot; small reports and scripts in this subdir

pre_effect_amendment.reason: Listed ordinary equity behavior focus: initial schema/value inventory shows restricted securities and nonquoted valuation; require level 1 unrestricted non-derivative before inspecting any change/flow outcomes. Preserve exclusion counts.

identity_clarification_before_effects.finding: Initial implementation conflated different funds free-text issuer titles with actual identity conflict. Five raw examples have same CUSIP and same valid LEI, with vendor-specific suffix/punctuation. No flow or quantity-change statistics viewed.
identity_clarification_before_effects.rule: Across funds require exact CUSIP, NS, USD and identical valid 20-character alphanumeric LEI; differing free-text title is diagnostic only when those identifiers agree. Missing, invalid or conflicting LEI cannot provide a peer. Within each fund across dates and duplicate rows retain original conservative title and LEI conflict exclusion.
identity_clarification_before_effects.interpretation: measurement correction before effects, not outcome-selected threshold relaxation
